title: AssetAttribute
description: This schema defines the AssetAttribute entity. An AssetAttribute defines a property template that can be used by different AssetTypes.

id.description: Unique identifier of an asset attribute instance.

displayName.description: Display Name that identifies this asset attribute.

updatedAt.description: Last update time corresponding to the new version of the entity in Unix epoch time milliseconds.

href.description: Link to the resource corresponding to this entity.

attributeCategory.description: Category of the attribute for grouping. Predefined values: basic, technical, business, quality, security. Custom values can be added via extension.

dataType.description: Data type of the attribute value. Predefined values: string, number, date, boolean, text, array. Custom types can be added via extension.

required.description: Whether this attribute is required when creating a DataAsset.

assignableRoles.description: List of roles that are allowed to fill/edit this attribute. Empty list means all roles can edit.

reviewers.description: User references of the reviewers for this asset attribute.

changeDescription.description: Change that lead to this version of the entity.

incrementalChangeDescription.description: Incremental change that lead to this version of the entity.

deleted.description: When `true` indicates the entity has been soft deleted.

dataProducts.description: List of data products this entity is part of.

extension.description: Entity extension data with custom attributes added to the entity. Use this to extend attributeCategory and dataType enums.
